title: In Silico Investigation of Candidate Anticancer Targets for Aryltetralin Lignans Previously Reported from Cleistanthus Species.
authors: Nguyen, Lam-Hong; Nguyen, Thi-Thanh-Thuy; Nguyen, Dac-Nhan; Mai, Quang-Minh; Le, Thang; Pham-The, Hai; Pham, Van-Cuong; Doan, Thi-Mai-Huong; Tran, Viet-Hung; Thai, Khac-Minh
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接与MD研究Cleistanthus木脂素类天然产物与TOP2B-DNA、Bcl-2、p53等抗癌靶点的结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA复合物建模，但核心是药物-靶点筛选而非TF-DNA互作机制，方法可部分借鉴但对象偏离本课题。
abstract: Aryltetralin lignans isolated from the fruits of Cleistanthus species exhibit substantial cytotoxic activity, although the molecular interactions underlying these effects remain incompletely understood. This study combined computational target investigation with previously published experimental chemical characterization and cytotoxic evidence and no new isolation or cytotoxicity experiments were carried out. Cleistantoxin, 7-hydroxypicropolygamain, neo-cleistantoxin, cleisindoside A, cleisindoside D, and cleistonkinin D were previously isolated from C. indochinensis, C. tonkinensis, C. eberhardtii and characterized by complementary spectroscopic methods. Cleistantoxin showed potent activity against MCF-7, multidrug-resistant MCF-7R, and HT29 cells, with reported IC(50) values of 0.036, 0.014, and 0.035 muM, respectively. Structural similarity to podophyllotoxin-derived anticancer agents guided the investigation of DNA topoisomerase IIbeta, Bcl-2, and p53 Y220C as candidate targets. Docking with AutoDock Vina-GPU 2.1 was validated by redocking the co-crystallized inhibitors (RMSD < 2 A at the TOP2B and Bcl-2 sites; the p53 Y220C control is reported for both receptor preparations), and selected complexes were simulated in triplicate for 100 ns, followed by MM-GBSA calculations and ADMET predictions. Cleisindoside A and D kept etoposide-like hydrogen bonds to DNA in the TOP2B-DNA complex. Their MM-GBSA binding energies were -78.40 +/- 3.73 and -81.90 +/- 7.84 kcal.mol(-1) for two ligand copies, comparable to -79.62 +/- 5.14 kcal.mol(-1) for etoposide. In Bcl-2, S-10r was clearly more favorable than cleisindoside D. The predicted pharmacokinetic profiles differentiated the aglycones from the glycosides and identified potential cytochrome P450 inhibition liabilities. By linking previously reported experimentally characterized natural products and cytotoxic evidence with molecular modeling, this study provides testable hypotheses for the molecular recognition of Cleistanthus lignans. Direct biochemical and mechanism-focused cellular studies are nevertheless required to validate the proposed targets.
abstract_zh: 从Cleistanthus属植物果实中分离得到的芳基四氢萘木脂素表现出显著的细胞毒活性，尽管这些效应背后的分子相互作用仍未完全阐明。本研究将计算靶点调查与此前发表的实验化学表征和细胞毒证据相结合，未开展新的分离或细胞毒实验。Cleistantoxin、7-hydroxypicropolygamain、neo-cleistantoxin、cleisindoside A、cleisindoside D和cleistonkinin D此前已从C. indochinensis、C. tonkinensis、C. eberhardtii中分离，并通过互补的光谱方法进行了表征。Cleistantoxin对MCF-7、多药耐药MCF-7R和HT29细胞表现出强效活性，其IC(50)值分别为0.036、0.014和0.035 muM。与鬼臼毒素衍生的抗癌药物在结构上的相似性，指导了对DNA拓扑异构酶IIbeta、Bcl-2和p53 Y220C作为候选靶点的研究。使用AutoDock Vina-GPU 2.1进行的对接通过重新对接共结晶抑制剂得到验证（在TOP2B和Bcl-2位点的RMSD < 2 Å；p53 Y220C对照针对两种受体制备方式均有报告），选定的复合物以三份重复进行100 ns模拟，随后进行MM-GBSA计算和ADMET预测。Cleisindoside A和D在TOP2B-DNA复合物中保持了类似依托泊苷的与DNA的氢键。它们对两个配体拷贝的MM-GBSA结合能分别为-78.40 ± 3.73和-81.90 ± 7.84 kcal.mol(-1)，与依托泊苷的-79.62 ± 5.14 kcal.mol(-1)相当。在Bcl-2中，S-10r明显优于cleisindoside D。预测的药代动力学特征将苷元与糖苷区分开来，并识别出潜在的细胞色素P450抑制风险。通过将此前报道的实验表征天然产物和细胞毒证据与分子建模联系起来，本研究为Cleistanthus木脂素的分子识别提供了可检验的假说。然而，仍需直接的生化和以机制为中心的细胞研究来验证所提出的靶点。
